component.name: Audio Sleep Control
component.summary: Keep your speaker output from going to sleep

description.p: Linux puts sound outputs to sleep when nothing is playing. With some speakers that causes pops, cut-off sound at the start of playback, or speakers dropping into their own standby.
Audio Sleep Control shows the state of your output and gives you two switches:

ul.li: Keep the speaker output awake (a WirePlumber rule for your user)
Turn off the HDA sound chip's power saving (asks for your password)
